title: Volcano Engine Launches Doubao Search Service to Provide Reliable Internet Retrieval Capabilities for AI Agents
excerpt: Volcanic Engine has officially launched Doubao Search Service, providing enterprises and developers with cross-language, multimodal, and vertical category netwo
content_html:
Volcanic Engine has officially launched Doubao Search Service, providing enterprises and developers with cross-language, multimodal, and vertical category network information query capabilities, offering real-time and trustworthy information support for AI agents, and promoting intelligent agents to evolve from simple Q&A to complex task execution.

As AI agents gradually take on long-process tasks, traditional single search and information retrieval methods are no longer sufficient. The new generation of intelligent agents not only need to obtain information but also need continuous searching, understanding web content, cross-verifying results, and dynamically adjusting retrieval strategies according to task progress. Doubao Search has been optimized to directly output original Markdown and structured data suitable for agent calls, and supports precise queries, semantic expansion, multi-round retrieval enhancement, and other capabilities.

Regarding information credibility, Doubao Search has established a source authority classification system, governing quality from two dimensions: websites and creators. It combines global Internet information, industry professional knowledge, and ByteDance's exclusive content resources to reduce the impact of low-quality content and search optimization content on results, providing more reliable information sources for agents.

According to the introduction, Doubao Search has shown outstanding performance in several public evaluations such as SimpleQA, FreshQA, and BrowseComp-ZH. It continuously optimizes in scenarios such as factual Q&A, time-sensitive information acquisition, and complex retrieval, improving the accuracy of information when intelligent agents handle real business tasks.

Currently, Doubao Search has been applied in multiple fields such as knowledge Q&A, office collaboration, financial services, business analysis, and content production. In AI assistant scenarios, Doubao Search has become the information engine behind the smart assistants of most leading mobile phone manufacturers in China; in office, financial research, and business analysis scenarios, it provides agents with real-time news, industry data, and context building capabilities.

In terms of access methods, Doubao Search supports various development approaches including independent API, Skill, MCP, and more. It can also be enabled with one-click configuration through Volcanic Engine Agent Plan, without additional integration, to add online retrieval capabilities to intelligent agents. This service also provides 500 free searches per month, with pay-as-you-go after exceeding, and offers monthly card packages to meet large-scale calling needs.

As AI agents gradually become an important entry point for enterprise intelligent applications, search capabilities are evolving from basic information acquisition tools into essential infrastructure for intelligent agent decision-making and execution. The launch of Doubao Search also reflects that the competition in the AI industry is expanding from model capabilities to a comprehensive competition in data, toolchains, and application ecosystems.

content_html_zh:
火山引擎正式上线豆宝搜索服务，为企业和开发者提供跨语言、多模态、垂直品类的网络信息查询能力，为AI智能体提供实时可信的信息支持，推动智能智能体从简单的问答向复杂的任务执行演进。

随着人工智能代理逐渐承担长流程任务，传统的单一搜索和信息检索方法已不再足够。 新一代智能代理不仅需要获取信息，还需要不断搜索、理解网页内容、交叉验证结果，并根据任务进度动态调整检索策略。 豆宝搜索经过优化，可直接输出适合座席调用的原始Markdown和结构化数据，并支持精准查询、语义扩展、多轮检索增强等能力。

在信息可信度方面，豆宝搜索建立了来源权威分级体系，从网站和创作者两个维度进行质量监管。 它结合了全球互联网信息、行业专业知识以及字节跳动的独家内容资源，减少低质量内容和搜索优化内容对结果的影响，为代理商提供更可靠的信息来源。

据介绍，豆宝搜索在SimpleQA、FreshQA、BrowseComp-ZH等多项公开评测中表现出色。 在事实问答、时效性信息获取、复杂检索等场景中不断优化，提高智能代理处理真实业务任务时信息的准确性。

目前，豆宝搜索已应用于知识问答、办公协作、金融服务、商业分析、内容生产等多个领域。 在AI助手场景中，豆宝搜索已成为国内大多数领先手机厂商智能助手背后的信息引擎；在办公、金融研究、商业分析场景中，为座席提供实时新闻、行业数据、情境构建能力。

在接入方式上，豆宝搜索支持独立API、Skill、MCP等多种开发方式。 还可以通过火山引擎代理计划一键配置启用，无需额外集成，为智能代理添加在线检索功能。 该服务还提供每月500次免费搜索，超出后按量付费，并提供月卡套餐，满足大规模通话需求。

随着AI Agent逐渐成为企业智能应用的重要入口，搜索能力正从基本的信息获取工具演变为智能Agent决策和执行的重要基础设施。 豆宝搜索的上线也反映出，人工智能行业的竞争正在从模型能力的竞争拓展到数据、工具链、应用生态的全面竞争。
